title: Close Babulus storage and CDN authorization gaps
description: apps/studio-web/amplify/storage/resource.ts gives every signed-in user read/write/delete on org/*. The CloudFront auth edge function (amplify/edge-functions/auth) decodes JWTs without verifying them and has no org check (the distribution is currently commented out). Serve org media through server-authorized presigned URLs checked against Prospectus, keep published/* public, and delete or rebuild the edge function. Coordinate with babulus-a7da61 (render worker IAM auth). Depends on the data-scoping task.
